financing.summary: NVR (Ryan Homes, NVHomes, Heartland Homes) is the purest land-light model among large US builders: it controls about 185,300 lots, of which about 176,000 (95%) sit under finished-lot purchase agreements (LPAs) with third-party developers, backed by about $1.03 billion of forfeitable cash deposits; it owns almost no land (one parcel of about 1,450 lots) and holds four minority land JVs. Its own balance sheet is net cash: $1.09 billion of homebuilding cash against a single $900 million 3.00% note due May 2030, an undrawn $300 million Bank of America revolver to March 2030 and an undrawn $150 million U.S. Bank mortgage repurchase line; Moody's rates it A3. It returns cash through buybacks ($1.82 billion in 2025, $1.23 billion in the first nine months of 2026) rather than buying land. For a land banker the opening is the developer side: NVR does not take land-bank options itself in any public source, but every lot it buys comes from a developer who must finance horizontal development, and NVR assigns its raw-land contracts (about 38,700 lots) to developers and signs LPAs with them. Deposit stress is rising (allowance up to $156 million on about 24,000 LPA lots), which points to developers and lot prices under strain in some of its markets.
financing.land_strategy: Land-light by design and in the company's own words: NVR generally does not develop land and buys substantially all finished lots under LPAs with forfeitable deposits (typically up to 10% of the lot price), so its exposure is limited to the deposit. Raw land it contracts for is normally assigned to a developer, who then sells NVR the finished lots under an LPA; it develops land itself only rarely (one parcel left, about 1,450 lots) and buys some lots through minority JVs. No numeric option target is stated; in practice about 95% of controlled lots are under LPAs.

lots.note: Owned = land under development only (about 1,450 lots, carrying value $21.8M); a further about 7,850 lots come from four minority JVs ($80.2M invested) and are in the total but in neither owned nor optioned. NVR does not report finished lots held in house inventory as a separate count. pct_optioned = 176,000/185,300. Years supply computed by us: 185,300 / trailing-12-month settlements of 20,009 (FY2025 21,915 minus 9M2025 16,247 plus 9M2026 14,341, from the 10-K and Q3 release). Excludes about 38,700 lots under raw-land contracts ($46.7M deposits, about $13M refundable). Trend: 162,400 (2024-12-31), 175,300 (2025-09-30), 180,100 (2025-12-31; Mid Atlantic 60,100, North East 19,000, Mid East 28,100, South East 72,900 per FY2025 10-K), 185,300 (2026-09-30).

land_banking.counterparty: Third-party land developers (unnamed; finished-lot purchase agreements)
land_banking.description: NVR's core lot pipeline: about 176,000 finished lots under LPAs with unconsolidated third-party developers (VIEs), secured by about $1,026.4M of cash deposits and $9.9M of letters of credit; NVR's loss on non-performance is generally limited to the deposit. About 24,000 of these lots carry a $156.4M deposit-impairment allowance (up from $111.0M on 18,200 lots at 2025-12-31).
land_banking.source_title: NVR 10-Q Q3 2026, Note: Variable Interest Entities
land_banking.note: Counterparties are not named in any filing. Amount = cash deposits, not lot purchase price; aggregate purchase price is not disclosed.

land_banking.counterparty: Landowners (raw-land purchase agreements, to be assigned to developers)
land_banking.description: Contracts on raw land expected to yield about 38,700 lots, with $46.7M of cash deposits (about $13.0M refundable). NVR expects to assign each feasible contract to a developer and then sign an LPA with that developer for the finished lots: this is the moment a developer needs horizontal-development capital.
land_banking.source_title: NVR 10-Q Q3 2026, Note: Variable Interest Entities
land_banking.note: Not included in the 185,300 lots controlled.

land_banking.counterparty: Unnamed developer (JV interest sale with LPA back)
land_banking.description: In Q1 2026 NVR sold its stake in one land JV to a developer for about $21.8M and signed an LPA giving NVR an option to buy the finished lots that developer will produce, converting a JV position into a pure option.
land_banking.note: Developer not named; transaction occurred in the quarter ended 2026-03-31.

land_banking.counterparty: Unnamed developer (land parcel sale with LPA back)
land_banking.description: In Q1 2026 NVR sold a raw land parcel it was developing to a developer for about $24.5M and took an LPA option on the finished lots, cutting owned land under development from about 2,300 to about 1,450 expected lots.
land_banking.source_title: NVR 10-Q Q3 2026, Note: Land Under Development
land_banking.note: Developer not named; transaction occurred in the quarter ended 2026-03-31. Lot count of the parcel sold not disclosed.

land_banking.description: Master developer of Saratoga Springs (Clay County, FL) sold NVR 78 finished lots in the Sagebrooke 55+ section across 13 deeds, recorded 2026-03-06 to 2026-08-04, for about $14.28M ($160k to $210k per lot on the August takedowns): a phased lot-takedown pattern.
land_banking.note: Article does not say whether an option, land bank or LPA sits behind the deeds.

land_banking.description: Sellers of about 153 acres in the Kinfield master plan (I-75/SR 52, Pasco County, FL) to Ryan Homes for a planned 556-home community; price undisclosed. A raw-land purchase by NVR, unusual for its model.
land_banking.note: Buyer entity given only as Ryan Homes; deeds not yet in public records per the article. Whether NVR will assign it to a developer or a land banker is not public.

land_banking.description: Master developer of Center\West (Poppleton, West Baltimore) signed an agreement with NVR Ryan Homes for 180 for-sale homes (132 townhomes, 48 condos) on about seven acres; terms not disclosed.
land_banking.note: Pre-2025, kept as a named developer counterparty in NVR's home market.

land_banking.description: Example of NVR's LPA terms: Ballenger Run (Frederick, MD) LPA for 85 single-family lots plus related LPAs, $5.6M aggregate deposit, lot price escalating 0.75% per quarter, rolling minimum of available lots.
land_banking.source_title: Lot Purchase Agreement, Ballenger Run (HF Enterprises S-1 Ex. 10.7, filed 2019-12-23)
land_banking.note: Stale (2014 agreement, copy on Law Insider of an SEC exhibit); shown only as the public template of NVR's LPA economics.

debt.note: Issued in three tranches ($600M at a discount, yield 3.02%; $300M in two taps at a premium, yield 2.00%); carrying value $907.7M; interest paid May 15 / Nov 15. NVR's only debt.

debt.instrument: Senior unsecured revolving credit facility (Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, 2025-03-11)
debt.rate: Term SOFR + 0.90% (investment-grade pricing); leverage grid SOFR + 1.00% to 1.625%
debt.lenders_agent: Bank of America, N.A. (administrative agent, L/C issuer); BofA Securities sole lead arranger
debt.source_title: NVR Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (8-K Ex. 10.1, 2025-03-12)
debt.note: Uncommitted accordion to $600M; $100M L/C sublimit with about $15.4M of letters of credit outstanding at 2026-09-30; no borrowings (10-Q Q3 2026 debt note). Covenants: max leverage, interest coverage/min liquidity, min tangible net worth. Other lenders not named in the public exhibit.

debt.lenders_agent: U.S. Bank National Association (agent and buyer)
debt.note: Non-recourse to NVR, collateralised by mortgage loans held for sale; extended to 2027-07-08 by Fifth Amendment effective 2026-07-10; no borrowings.

Entered the Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement: $300M unsecured revolver (accordion to $600M), maturity extended from 2026-02-11 to 2030-03-11, Bank of America agent.
Board authorised up to $750M of share repurchases.
Board authorised a further $750M of share repurchases.
FY2025 repurchases: 243,082 shares for about $1,818.6M; about $549.6M of authorisation left at year end.
Board authorised a further $750M of share repurchases.
Q1 2026: sold one JV interest (about $21.8M) and one land parcel (about $24.5M) to developers, taking LPA options back on the finished lots: off-balance-sheet conversion of owned/JV land.

capital_events.description: Board authorised a further $750M of share repurchases (no expiry).
Fifth Amendment to the NVR Mortgage Finance repurchase agreement with U.S. Bank extended maturity to 2027-07-08 (size $150M).
Nine months 2026 repurchases: 181,984 shares for about $1,227.0M (Q3: 37,088 shares, $237.2M).

joint_ventures.description: Four land-development JVs in which NVR is a non-controlling member, $80.2M invested plus $19.5M further commitments, expected to yield about 7,850 finished lots that NVR buys under LPAs. Down from five JVs / about 8,900 lots at 2025-12-31 after one stake was sold to a developer in Q1 2026.
joint_ventures.note: Partners not named in filings. The filing describes NVR both as non-controlling member and (in one phrase) as controlling the JV lots; read as NVR controlling the lots, not the entities.

key_metrics.credit_ratings: Net cash (net debt to capital -4.2% on homebuilding cash $1,091.3M; cash_usd_m includes $34.1M mortgage-banking cash; liquidity = homebuilding cash + $284.6M unused revolver). Moody's A3 (stable, upgraded 2025-03-10); the 2025 credit agreement states NVR was rated A-/A3 or higher by at least two of S&P, Moody's and Fitch at closing (2025-03-11)

gaps: M&A 2025-2026: none found. NVR filed no 8-K under Item 2.01 or 1.01 for an acquisition in 2025-2026 (EDGAR filing list checked), its releases list none, and a search found no deal; its last brand acquisition (Heartland Homes) is historic. Footprint grew organically from 36 to 37 metros (16 states + DC) between the FY2024 and FY2025 10-Ks; the new metro is not named in the sources read.

Land-banking counterparties: no public source links NVR or Ryan Homes to Millrose, Kennedy Lewis, TPG Angelo Gordon, Domain, Varde, IHP, Essential Housing, Brookfield or other land bankers; the developers behind the 176,000 LPA lots are not named in filings (they may themselves be land-bank or private-credit funded: not publicly disclosed).
Aggregate purchase price of lots under LPA: not publicly disclosed (only deposits).
Revolver syndicate beyond Bank of America: not in the public exhibit (Schedule 2.01 and signature pages not reachable in the EDGAR copy).
S&P and Fitch current ratings: not confirmed from an opened source (credit agreement only implies at least one besides Moody's is A-/A3 or higher as of 2025-03).
